notes.title: We are under 24hr from Release!!!
notes.notes:
After long anticipation for the last few months, the day is here. The Horrors of the game are packed and ready to rock and roll! It has been quite a journey since the creation of the project.

Honestly, as a Solo Developer, releasing this is like a big weight getting off my chest. I have played this game a thousand times, and now I want you to play it, even once, it actually means a lot. I want to make games forever, as hard as it is, I love it more. We do and we learn. Hope you like this one, there will be more to come. 

I hope you enjoy! 


The game will launch tomorrow [b]FEB. 20th at 18:30CET / 12:30EST[/b], with a discounted price of $9.89 for the first week from launch. 

Thank you!
[i]Veilshift Games[/i]

notes.title: BH:S Demo Update v1.1.0 is live!
notes.notes:
[b]The Announced Update for the Demo is now Live! Here's what's changed:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug Fixes (cutscene glitches, game restarting, AI improvements, Boss Fixes etc.
[*] Performance Improvement (game is now smaller in size and runs better overall)
[*] Visual Improvements (the game looks a bit better now, better shadows, more items)
[*] Hints ( we added hints for easier playthrough)
[*] Collectables and Tapes (find inspectable items and tapes you can listen to)
and more! 
[/list]

[b]Have a great weekend and thank you for playing! [/b]
[i]Veilshift Games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes - October 30th
notes.notes:
[h1]Upcoming October 30th Update[/h1]


[list]
[*]Bug Fixes, Hints, Improved Performance.

[*]More Interactions and Introduction of Collectables, Journal and Steam Leaderboards & Achievements!

[*]Ambient and General polish of the Demo, Simpler Walkthrough task-wise.
[/list]


Seeing all the players try out the Demo is simply amazing to see, and we truly hope you found it somewhat enjoyable... and to make sure we will roll out an Update for the Demo in 9 days, fixing everything and making it as close to the Final Game as possible.  

Speaking of the Final Game, the development is going strong, and Official Full Trailer will be released in coming weeks, with new screenshots and much more! And for the game, should be released by February 2025, at latest. (we hope!)



To wrap it up...

For everyone who played, a [b]BIG THANK YOU![/b] And for everyone who wants to play, we hope you enjoy!

Have a great week!
[i]Veilshift Games

notes.title: The Free Demo is officially Released! Give it a run!
notes.notes:
[b] BIOHAZARD: SIBERIA DEMO [/b]
    
[i]About the demo


The Demo is an Introduction to the game, which includes the first level. You play as Owen Reeves, a seemingly ordinary character, until the truth shows that there is a lot more under the surface.  

With a smooth performance and good optimisation, the Demo runs easily on most PCs! Enjoy the beautiful graphics, dynamic lighting, and realistic horrors that truly come alive in this Demo!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250470/122e2618f6c37ebe76787b4c42f0f76070fc88a7.png[/img]




[b]OUTBREAK[/b]

An Outbreak happens as you settle in your new station, and you must find a way out in a facility filled with deadly, crazy and scary Mutants, failed human experiments that broke loose. Limited Resources, Terror, Death, and Betrayal - is what awaits.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250470/3afb34f8176382366a73d0ec8009a9e84e2b8237.png[/img]


You soon find out that your reality is not what you think --- Dive into this twist-filled story that will give you goosebumps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250470/fe0e394d2a7684aebdd4745be96911bee188d4d2.png[/img]

Have a fun Sunday :)
[i]Veilshift Games
